title: Substitute
text: Let $$x=3\operatorname{sec}\left(\theta\right)$$. Then the integral becomes the integral of $$\frac{1}{9} \operatorname{csc}\left(\theta\right) \operatorname{cot}\left(\theta\right)$$ with respect to θ.

title: Integrate and convert back
text: The integral is $$-\left(\frac{1}{9}\right) \operatorname{csc}\left(\theta\right)$$, and csc(θ) is $$\frac{x}{\sqrt{x^2-9}}$$.
